blocks.html: When you request a quote, book a showroom visit or contact us, we collect your name, email, phone number, delivery address and the products you’re interested in. Our website may also use basic analytics and cookies to understand how it is used.

blocks.html: To prepare quotes, process and deliver orders, handle warranty claims, and reply to your questions. We share it only with the people needed to do that, such as manufacturers, freight carriers and installers.

blocks.html: You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or stop hearing from us, by emailing sales@thetorontosaunaco.com. We handle personal information in line with Canada’s Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
